text.en:
The Commission shall be an advisory body to the President and
shall exercise the following functions and responsibilities:
Articulate the development goals, objectives, programs and projects
of the Sical Region Tourism Master Plan;
Cause the update and refinement
of the Bicol Region Tourism
Master Plan within
the context of the Medium Term Philippine
Development
Plan, Regional Development
Plan, and the
Development Plan of the local government units (LGUs);
Cause the conduct of feasibility study, evaluation, and financing of
the project components of the BRTMP;
Provide overall direction,
coordination,
and supervision
planning, implementation and monitoring
of the BRTMP;
Enlist the support
and assistance
from government and non-
government institutions
in planning and implementing the BRTMP;
Enter into contracts as may be necessary in the implementation
the BRTMP, subject to existing laws, rules and regulations;
Organize the Project Management Office. define its organizationalset-up.
its i staff~ng pattern
Director and staff. subject to approval of the Department of Budget
and Management;
implementing
rules and regulations
pertaining
internal operations of the Project Management Office; and
Submit to the President quarterly progress reports on the Project
and such other reports as may be required.

The Commission may call upon any government agency, office
or bureau for assistance in the discharge of, and form committees to facilitate
the performance of, its functions and responsibilities.

The amount of Five Million Pesos (-PS,OOO,OOO.OO),
from funds of the DOT, shall be released for the operations of the Commission
for 1995. Appropriations
for the succeeding years shall be incorporated in the
budget proposals under the Office of the President.

All executive issuances, orders, rules and regulations,
thereof, inconsistent
with this Executive Order are hereby revoked or modifiedaccordins
